meaning: The header comment at Model_3/main_sweep.jl:19 states that the cerebral venous compliance sweep multiplies brain.Veins.C_v by 0, 0.8, 1, 1.2, 2. It is a documented claim about the actual scan behind the figures, including a zero-compliance case.

could_move.what: If the SWEEPS table in the script no longer matches this comment, figures read against the header are mislabelled in their parameter values.
The scale 0 removes venous compliance entirely, which can change or break the solve rather than just shift a curve; the same 0 is listed for k, G and tau.
The combined :CGk run overlays Cv with G, k and tau, so a wrong Cv scale list propagates into the combined panel set.
m4-based h-sweep figure sets inherit any mismatch in how sweep multipliers are documented.

expectation: Unknown. The SWEEPS table itself is not in this context, so I cannot tell whether the comment matches the code or by how much it is off.

check.why: Prints the real sweep definitions so the 0, 0.8, 1, 1.2, 2 claim for C_v can be checked against code without any solve or re-fit.
